caption: The drawing depicts a circular plate with a decorative pattern. In the center of the plate, there is a large, green eight-pointed star with each point tipped in red. The background within the plate is a pale greenish-yellow color. Surrounding the star is a dotted pinkish-red circular line. Around the edge of the plate, there is a border decorated with alternating green shapes resembling leaf clusters and semicircular reddish-brown segments. The rim of the plate is outlined with a thin yellow band and an outer brown line. The overall background of the drawing is plain and off-white with no additional objects or patterns outside of the plate design.
title: Small Plate
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
